competencies.statement: The learner can diagnose and resolve cloud service issues involving network, storage, and compute resources.
competencies.description: Isolates and fixes a cloud resource problem across those layers.

competencies.statement: The learner can assist a customer in deploying an application in a cloud environment.
competencies.description: Guides a working deployment to a cloud platform.

competencies.statement: The learner can analyze system logs and monitoring tools to identify performance bottlenecks.
competencies.description: Reads logs/metrics to locate a bottleneck.

competencies.statement: The learner can support incident-management processes and document troubleshooting steps.
competencies.description: Follows an incident process and records clear steps.

competencies.statement: The learner can use major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) proficiently.
competencies.description: Navigates core services on a major cloud platform.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure and manage virtual machines, containers, and serverless functions.
competencies.description: Provisions/manages the right compute abstraction for a need.

competencies.statement: The learner can explain cloud storage solutions and data lifecycle management.
competencies.description: Selects appropriate storage tier/lifecycle for a scenario.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement identity and access management (IAM) best practices.
competencies.description: Applies least-privilege IAM correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure a virtual private cloud (VPC), subnets, and security groups.
competencies.description: Designs a working VPC/subnet/security-group layout.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement cloud firewall and access-control policies.
competencies.description: Writes firewall/ACL rules that meet a requirement.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor and analyze network traffic using cloud-native tools.
competencies.description: Uses flow logs/tools to investigate traffic.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply encryption and compliance policies for data protection.
competencies.description: Chooses correct encryption in transit/at rest for data.

competencies.statement: The learner can write scripts in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for cloud automation.
competencies.description: Automates a cloud task with a correct script.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
competencies.description: Defines/updates infrastructure declaratively.

competencies.statement: The learner can automate deployment pipelines using CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
competencies.description: Builds a working CI/CD pipeline.

competencies.statement: The learner can optimize resource provisioning using autoscaling and serverless functions.
competencies.description: Applies autoscaling/serverless to fit demand and cost.

competencies.statement: The learner can communicate effectively with customers and internal teams.
competencies.description: Explains a technical issue clearly to the right audience.

competencies.statement: The learner can document and escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate teams.
competencies.description: Escalates with the right detail to the right owner.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct a technical training session for customers or internal stakeholders.
competencies.description: Delivers a clear, level-appropriate training.

competencies.statement: The learner can write detailed knowledge-base articles and technical documentation.
competencies.description: Produces accurate, reusable documentation.

competencies.statement: The learner can set up cloud monitoring solutions (e.g., CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Cloud Monitoring).
competencies.description: Configures monitoring for a service.

competencies.statement: The learner can respond to service outages and escalate critical issues.
competencies.description: Acts correctly during an outage and escalates appropriately.

competencies.statement: The learner can create dashboards to track cloud performance and service health.
competencies.description: Builds a dashboard surfacing the right signals.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement alerting mechanisms to notify teams of potential incidents.
competencies.description: Defines actionable alerts with sensible thresholds.

competencies.statement: The learner can ensure adherence to cloud security frameworks and compliance standards (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR).
competencies.description: Maps a requirement to the right compliance control.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct periodic security audits and implement remediation actions.
competencies.description: Finds and remediates a security gap.

competencies.statement: The learner can follow cloud-provider best practices for high availability and disaster recovery.
competencies.description: Designs for HA/DR to meet an RTO/RPO.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement backup and restoration procedures.
competencies.description: Sets up and verifies backups/restores.
